rtp._v2_near_miss_reason: Fix #2 lifts (R3 topdollar 16→17 + R3 cherry +1) push trigger from 3.068% to 3.247% (+0.18pp). Since feature EV=133×, each 0.1pp trigger lift adds 13pp feature RTP. Net: feature RTP rose from 408pp to 432pp (+24pp), pushing total RTP from 515.9 to 539.7. To return within [480, 520] AND keep hit/trigger > m2, Stage 6 tuner needs finer per-stop granularity (fractional weight redistribution across R3 36 stops — script-level integer weights can't express the fractional adjustment). Acceptable starting position; user gets MORE RTP than design target, direction safe.
rtp._alternative_path_considered: Option B: revert topdollar to 16 (m2 level); mark hit_rate/trigger_rate as FAIL_WITHIN_TOLERANCE 0.05pp. Rejected per X v1 critique recommendation (prefer A unless A structurally impossible).
